items.docs: Returns the `team` custom post type — 15 records covering the executive team (CEO, CMO, CSO, COO and SVPs), the board of directors and the scientific/business advisors. Each record carries structured Advanced Custom Fields: `team-job-title`, `team-credentials` and `team-bio`.
